tasks.title: HANGS Construction Services · Q3 2026 Seattle Business License Tax Return
tasks.description: Prepare the Q3 2026 City of Seattle business license tax (city B&O) return for HANGS Construction Services from 8 Excel, PDF, Word and email documents. Source each billing to its job-site city, deduct the work taxed by Bellevue and Tacoma and a bad debt, apply what is left of the 2026 standard deduction, and calculate the tax by classification. Produce formula-linked Excel workpapers and supported figures on an incomplete draft return, separate from the state excise return. Open items stay open for a person. This demo plays back one recorded run; the run’s real working time is shown at the end.
tasks.outputs: Two files: formula-linked Excel workpapers with evidence tabs, and an incomplete draft Seattle business license tax return PDF with evidence trails and original source attachments
tasks.gates: Incomplete draft, not reviewed, signed or filed. Missing evidence and differences stay open. A person reviews and files in FileLocal, separately from the state returns.
